'''Star Tours Flight 913''' was the designation of a [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency flight to [[Teyr/Legends|Teyr]]. On the morning of the [[Raid at Spaceport THX1138]], it was scheduled to arrive at the spaceport's Gate 1C at 0850 hours, but it was delayed. It was scheduled to depart again at 0945.
